name: declaration:
doc: 4GL section: declare tables, domains, and variables for the script.

name: functions:
doc: 4GL section: local functions used by the UI or report script.

name: before.program:
doc: 4GL program event: runs once when the session starts.

name: after.program:
doc: 4GL program event: runs when the session ends.

name: on.error:
doc: 4GL program event: handles runtime errors for the session.

name: after.update.db.commit:
doc: 4GL program event: runs after a database commit in the session.

name: before.display.object:
doc: 4GL program event: runs before an object is displayed on the form.

name: on.display.total.line:
doc: 4GL program event: runs when displaying a total line on the form.

name: before.new.object:
doc: 4GL program event: runs before a new object is created in the UI session.

name: after.new.object:
doc: 4GL program event: runs after a new object is created in the UI session.

name: after.form.read:
doc: 4GL program event: runs after form definition data is read.

name: after.receive.data:
doc: Report program event: runs when the report writer receives a data record.

name: before.report:
doc: Report layout parent: runs once before report output (use before.report.N:).

name: after.report:
doc: Report layout parent: runs once after report output (use after.report.N:).

name: header:
doc: Report layout parent: page/report header (use header.N: with layout number from DD).

name: footer:
doc: Report layout parent: page/report footer (use footer.N: with layout number from DD).

name: detail:
doc: Report layout parent: detail lines (use detail.N: with layout number from DD).

name: before.field.N:
doc: Report layout parent: before a sorted field break (numbered; not UI before.field:).

name: after.field.N:
doc: Report layout parent: after a sorted field break (numbered; not UI after.field:).

name: before.layout:
doc: Report layout child: runs before the layout is printed.

name: after.layout:
doc: Report layout child: runs after the layout is printed.

name: init.field:
doc: 4GL field event: initialize the field when the form is shown.

name: before.field:
doc: 4GL field event: runs when the cursor enters the field.

name: before.input:
doc: 4GL field event: runs before the user enters a value for the field.

name: before.display:
doc: 4GL field event: runs before the field value is displayed.

name: selection.filter:
doc: 4GL field event: restrict zoom/selection query for the field.

name: before.zoom:
doc: 4GL field event: runs before a zoom session is opened from the field.

name: before.checks:
doc: 4GL field event: runs before standard field checks.

name: domain.error:
doc: 4GL field event: handle domain validation errors for the field.

name: ref.input:
doc: 4GL field event: reference input handling for the field.

name: ref.display:
doc: 4GL field event: reference display handling for the field.

name: check.input:
doc: 4GL field event: validate the field value; can reject input.

name: on.input:
doc: 4GL field event: runs during field input processing.

name: when.field.changes:
doc: 4GL field event: runs when the field value changes.

name: after.zoom:
doc: 4GL field event: runs after returning from a zoom session.

name: after.input:
doc: 4GL field event: runs after input is complete for the field.

name: after.display:
doc: 4GL field event: runs after the field value is displayed.

name: after.field:
doc: 4GL field event: runs after the field value has been accepted.

name: init.form:
doc: 4GL form event: initialize the form when it is first shown.

name: before.form:
doc: 4GL form event: runs before the form is processed.

name: after.form:
doc: 4GL form event: runs after the form is processed.

name: init.group:
doc: 4GL group event: initialize a form group.

name: before.group:
doc: 4GL group event: runs before a form group is processed.

name: after.group:
doc: 4GL group event: runs after a form group is processed.

name: before.choice:
doc: 4GL choice event: runs before the choice is processed.

name: on.choice:
doc: 4GL choice event: runs when the user activates this choice/command.

name: after.choice:
doc: 4GL choice event: runs after the choice has been processed.

name: main.table.io:
doc: 4GL parent section: main table database I/O events.

name: read.view:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs when reading a view.

name: before.read:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs before reading a record.

name: after.read:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs after reading a record.

name: before.write:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs before inserting a new record.

name: after.write:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs after inserting a new record.

name: after.skip.write:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs after a skipped write.

name: before.rewrite:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs before updating an existing record.

name: after.rewrite:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs after updating an existing record.

name: after.skip.rewrite:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs after a skipped rewrite.

name: before.delete:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs before deleting a record.

name: after.delete:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs after deleting a record.

name: after.skip.delete:
doc: 4GL main table I/O: runs after a skipped delete.

name: on.entry:
doc: 4GL zoom event: runs when entering a zoom.from session.

name: on.exit:
doc: 4GL zoom event: runs when exiting a zoom.from session.
